Maria G.: Heads up — we've got a noisy telemetry pattern from the chatty /streaming/v1 routes. Token volume spikes are blowing through our ingest quota during spike tests.
Alex J.: Seen that. Is it the long-lived streams or per-message log sampling?
Maria G.: Mostly short-lived but very high QPS from a customer canary. Each request emits request + response + model-meta = 3x events.
Samir P.: For chatty routes we should consider delta-sampling: sample more aggressively after the first N messages in a session. TTL-based retention for samples too.
Katy L.: Agree on delta-sampling. Also we need consent-handoff: if a request is marked "consent=false" by the frontend, drop payloads upstream asap. Right now consent token gets lost when we proxy through edge aggregator.
Dino (oncall): ops-bot flagged 95% of spikes between 03:15-03:40 UTC today. Quick dump: /var/log/ingest/spikes-03-15.log (attached).
ops-bot: alert: quota_usage=92% for telemetry-ingest-prod; top-route=/streaming/v1; recent_incidents=0
Alex J.: Proposal: per-route sampler with these rules: 1) initial_session_sample=100% for first 3 messages, 2) session_tail_rate=5% after that, 3) per-session cap=200 events. That keeps debugging data but caps tail.
Maria G.: I like per-session cap. But what about diagnostic flags? If customer sets debug=1 we should allow higher sampling for that session but require explicit consent.
Samir P.: We can attach a signed consent token from the web client. Edge validates, includes a consent header that the ingest service respects. Need a secure TTL to avoid replay.
Katy L.: TTL on consent tokens is essential. If token is valid for too long, exfil risks go up. 2 minutes by default?
Alex J.: 2 min default ok, maybe configurable per-customer via console. Also need an audit log event when consent token is honored or rejected.
Dino (oncall): Operationally, can we implement a fallback where if quota is low we reduce session_tail_rate to 1% across all chatty routes automatically?
Maria G.: Yes — a global throttle override policy that can be triggered by quota thresholds makes sense. But UX in console needs to show how many sessions were affected.
Samir P.: Implementation sketch (pseudo YAML):
```
sampler:
  routes:
    "/streaming/v1":
      initial_session_sample: 1.0
      session_tail_rate: 0.05
      session_event_cap: 200
      consent_token_ttl_seconds: 120
  global_overrides:
    quota_threshold_pct: 85
    tail_rate_under_quota: 0.01
```
Katy L.: Will the sampler run at edge or in ingest? Running at edge prevents excess egress cost but edges are less trusted for redaction.
Alex J.: Tradeoff: edge sampler reduces network load but must send enough metadata for server-side redaction decisions. Maybe run a lightweight pre-sampler at edge (message count only) and authoritative sampler in ingest that enforces consent and redaction.
Maria G.: About redaction: we should never log raw user messages unless "consent=true". For sampled payloads with "consent=true", apply PII heuristics before indexing. Heuristics must be the same across environments.
Samir P.: Agree. Redaction pipeline: 1) consent check, 2) PII scrub (names, SSNs, emails), 3) redaction_score metadata. If scrub confidence < threshold, mark as "redaction_review" and anonymize further.
Dino (oncall): For oncall troubleshooting we sometimes need transient unredacted access. Can we support ephemeral unmask tokens tied to audit logs + approval flow?
Katy L.: Yes but keep approvals in the control plane. Request -> approver -> short-lived unmask token (30s) plus audit entries. No bypass.
Alex J.: UX: console should show per-route sampling config, current effective tail_rate after overrides, and a small simulator to paste a session and get expected sampling outcome.
Maria G.: Action items: Alex to draft config schema + console UI copy. Samir to prototype consent token validation + TTL. Katy to write redaction heuristics doc with failure modes. Dino to add quota-based override to oncall runbook. I'll coordinate a sync next Tue. :thumbsup:
Alex J.: I'll open a PR with the schema and a lightweight simulator (server-side) by EOD Fri.
Samir P.: I'll put a quick PoC service in sandbox and share logs.
Katy L.: Drafting heuristics doc now, will post link when ready.
Dino (oncall): I'll add quick health checks to detect "tail-sample surge" and page if it crosses 5x baseline.
Maria G.: Thanks team — let's keep the conversation in this thread for implementation questions.
